dct_description_sm: " ... issued originally in 1598, then at six different periods until 1618." Includes a sea monster in the Aethiopicus Oceanus. Highly detailed coastline. Title across top: La Pointe d'Afrique. Top right: 105. Bottom right: Cgs.
Appears in: Barent Langene's Caert Thressor (1606)

Norwich, I., Pam Kolbe, and Jeffrey C Stone. Norwich's Maps of Africa: An Illustrated and Annotated Carto-Bibliography. 2nd ed. / rev. and edited by Jeffrey C. Stone. Norwich, Vt.: Terra Nova Press, 1997, map 0153, p. 173
David Rumsey Map Center copy 1: Norwich no. NOR 0153.
